name: ScreenshotOne
summary: Render a web page, HTML or Markdown to an image or PDF in a real browser, with ad and cookie-banner blocking, element capture and page metadata.

access_key.description: A ScreenshotOne access key (dashboard > Access). Sent as the access_key query parameter, the form every endpoint documents (take also accepts an X-Access-Key header).

notes: A rendered screenshot counts against the plan's quota; results served from cache (cache=true) do not. GET /usage is free.
The answer is the image or PDF bytes by default (Content-Type by format); set response_type=json for a JSON answer. Errors are JSON with an error code and message.
Signed requests (a signature parameter) are optional unless signing enforcement is turned on for the key; this entry sends the key unsigned.
omit_background works only with png; webp and jpeg refuse it even as false.

endpoints.name: Take a screenshot of a URL
endpoints.summary: Render a page and return the image, PDF, HTML or Markdown.

url.description: Page to capture; one of url, html or markdown is required.

full_page.description: Capture the whole scrollable page, default false.

selector.description: CSS selector of the one element to capture.

dark_mode.description: true asks the page for dark mode, false for light.

delay.description: Seconds to wait before capturing, default 0.

wait_until.description: Navigation events to wait for, default [load]; values load, domcontentloaded, networkidle0, networkidle2.

wait_for_selector.description: Wait until this CSS selector is in the DOM.

ip_country_code.description: Country of the exit IP, default us (us, gb, de, it, fr, cn, ca, es, jp, kr, in, au, br, mx, nz, pe, is, ie).

response_type.description: by_format returns the file; json returns a JSON answer (with the metadata_* results); empty returns nothing.

cache.description: Cache the result; cached hits do not use quota.

cache_ttl.description: Cache lifetime in seconds, 14400 to 2592000; needs cache=true.

metadata_content.description: Upload the page content and return its URL.

notes: Uses one render from the quota unless served from cache.
Over 30 seconds of delay is only allowed for async requests with a longer timeout.

endpoints.name: Take a screenshot from a JSON body
endpoints.summary: Same as take, with options as JSON; the way to send large html or markdown.

url.description: Page to capture; one of url, html or markdown is required.

html.description: HTML to render instead of a URL.

markdown.description: Markdown to render instead of a URL.

full_page.description: Capture the whole scrollable page, default false.

selector.description: CSS selector of the one element to capture.

dark_mode.description: true asks the page for dark mode, false for light.

delay.description: Seconds to wait before capturing, default 0.

wait_until.description: Navigation events to wait for, default [load]; values load, domcontentloaded, networkidle0, networkidle2.

wait_for_selector.description: Wait until this CSS selector is in the DOM.

ip_country_code.description: Country of the exit IP, default us (us, gb, de, it, fr, cn, ca, es, jp, kr, in, au, br, mx, nz, pe, is, ie).

response_type.description: by_format returns the file; json returns a JSON answer (with the metadata_* results); empty returns nothing.

cache.description: Cache the result; cached hits do not use quota.

cache_ttl.description: Cache lifetime in seconds, 14400 to 2592000; needs cache=true.

metadata_content.description: Upload the page content and return its URL.

notes: A read over POST. Body limit 100 MiB; for very large HTML host it and pass url instead.
Uses one render from the quota unless served from cache.

endpoints.name: Get quota usage
endpoints.summary: Requests allowed, used and available in the period, and the per-minute concurrency bucket.
notes: Free; a 400 with error_code access_key_invalid means the key is wrong. concurrency.reset is a UNIX time in nanoseconds.
